fat_pct.quote: The corresponding composition of both Präst varieties was 22% protein and 35% fat, of which 22% comprised saturated fat.

salt_pct.quote: All cheese types contained 1.2% salt and no carbohydrates.

ammonia.reason: Low ammonia from deamination of amino acids by NSLAB during 12-18 mo ripening, no surface flora.

animal_barnyard.reason: Very low p-cresol/indole from Tyr/Trp catabolism; pasteurized cow milk, no washed rind.

bitter.reason: Moderate hydrophobic peptides from chymosin/plasmin proteolysis, mostly degraded by Lactobacillus peptidases.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation, no methyl ketones from blue mold lipolysis.

browning.reason: Good Maillard browning from free amino acids and residual galactose in cooked low-moisture curd on heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate metabolism by Lactococcus/Leuconostoc starter in washed-cooked curd.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Moderate butanoic/hexanoic acids from milk lipase and starter esterase lipolysis during long ripening.

creaminess.reason: 35% fat, 45-50% FDM gives smooth mouthfeel but firm aged matrix limits creaminess.

crumbliness.reason: Calcium phosphate solubilization and proteolysis plus tyrosine crystals at 12 mo create moderate fracture.

firmness.reason: Cooked, pressed semi-hard paste at ~40% moisture aged 12 mo gives firm elastic body.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine Strecker degradation by NSLAB.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from esterification of free fatty acids with ethanol from heterofermentative NSLAB.

goaty.reason: Cow milk lacks caprine 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic acids; no goat-milk lipase signature.

malty_nutty.reason: High 2-/3-methylbutanal and 2-methylpropanal from Leu/Ile/Val Strecker degradation, signature nutty Präst note.

melt.reason: Rennet-coagulated, pH ~5.3 calcium-paracasein network flows on heating, not acid-set.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Trace 1-octen-3-ol from linoleic acid oxidation; no mushroom rind flora.

oil_off.reason: Moderate free oil from 35% fat coalesced fat globules in aged protein matrix on melting.

smoky.reason: No wood smoking step, no guaiacol/syringol phenols applied.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic and low acetic acid from starter/NSLAB fermentation; lactose depleted, pH stabilized.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water stretching; cooked rennet curd shows only slight plastic flow.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low H2S/methional from Met catabolism and whey protein denaturation in ~42C cooked curd.

sweet.reason: Sweet proline/glycerol and dihydroxyacetone notes plus low acid masking, no residual lactose.

umami.reason: High free glutamate from extensive chymosin/plasmin plus Lactobacillus paracasei proteolysis over 12 mo.
